mapper.select: SELECT ID ,BIZ_NO ,LOGIN ,PASSWORD ,NAME ,TEL ,EMAIL ,HIRE_DATE ,GENDER_CD ,get_sub_code_name(GENDER_CD)"GENDER_NM" ,ADMIN_CD ,get_sub_code_name(ADMIN_CD) as "ADMIN_NM" ,STATUS_CD ,get_sub_code_name(STATUS_CD) "STATUS_NM" ,CREATED_ON ,PW_UPDATED_ON ,PRJ_MANAGER_CD ,get_sub_code_name(PRJ_MANAGER_CD) "PRJ_MANAGER_NM" ,MCP_CD ,get_sub_code_name(MCP_CD) "MCP_NM" FROM users WHERE biz_no = #{bizNo} AND login = #{login}
SELECT BIZ_NO ,COMPANY_NAME FROM COMPANY WHERE IS_ACTIVE_CD = '01ACTIVE' AND COMPANY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY COMPANY_NAME ASC
